behaviors.search-assignees: Open the assignee picker and search for a person by name to narrow its options.
behaviors.filter-by-assignee: Choose a person or Unassigned to show only matching tasks and update the visible-task summary.
behaviors.assignee-task-counts: See each assignee option’s task count in the picker.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Choose Ana Lima to see the new “Nothing assigned to Ana yet” empty state and its Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: After applying filters, use Clear filters to restore all statuses and Anyone and show the full task list.
